reasons.D: The only set that reads as gothic lolita from the high camera: crimson leads, the scalloped tiered skirt flares into a real bell, the bell sleeves show, and the black bow-on-band headdress is a crisp toy accent; first fix: the forearm bells sit at hip level and widen the waist, so lift or narrow them.
reasons.B: The best silhouette: a narrow laced bodice over an A-line that falls in tiers to the ankles, with a veiled bowed headdress, solemn and clearly a dress; first fix: almost all black from above, so give the skirt tiers a crimson or bone edge that reads at the ARPG camera.
reasons.F: The richest classic-catalog details (clock-face waist bow, brass key, studded lace band, clock on the headdress) on a stepped bell; first fix: at 100 parts it is at the budget, and the stacked tiers read as a layered cake from above, so merge two tiers.
